}

  { n: 5052, author: 'steveyegge', title: 'fix(backup): run backup sync/restore on an undeadlined one-shot connection' },
  { n: 5066, author: 'steveyegge', title: 'fix(update): refuse overwriting a live foreign claim without --force' },

]
const VERDICT = {
  type: 'object',
  required: ['number', 'verdict', 'summary', 'findings', 'recommendation'],
  properties: {
    number: { type: 'integer' },
    verdict: { type: 'string', enum: ['approve', 'approve-with-nits', 'needs-changes', 'decline', 'blocked-cannot-assess'] },
    summary: { type: 'string', description: '2-4 sentence assessment of what the PR does and whether it is correct' },
    findings: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', required: ['severity', 'detail'], properties: {
      severity: { type: 'string', enum: ['blocker', 'major', 'minor', 'nit'] },
      detail: { type: 'string', description: 'concrete finding with file:line where possible' },
    } } },
    ci_state: { type: 'string' },
    overlap: { type: 'string', description: 'any overlap/conflict with other open PRs or recently-merged work, or empty' },
    recommendation: { type: 'string', description: 'one-line next action for the maintainer' },
  },
}

`You are a read-only PR reviewer for the beads project (gastownhall/beads). Review PR #${pr.n} by ${pr.author}: "${pr.title}".

STRICT RULES:
- READ-ONLY. Do not edit files, do not commit, do not run bd write commands.
- Do NOT post anything to GitHub: no gh pr review, no gh pr comment, no gh api POST/PATCH. Only read operations (gh pr view/diff/checks, gh api GET).
- Do not check out branches or create worktrees.

Steps:
1. gh pr view ${pr.n} --repo gastownhall/beads --json title,body,state,mergeable,baseRefName,headRefName,files,additions,deletions,comments
2. gh pr diff ${pr.n} --repo gastownhall/beads (if very large, review file-by-file via gh api GET)
3. gh pr checks ${pr.n} --repo gastownhall/beads || true  (record CI state)
4. Read the touched code paths in the local upstream checkout at /var/home/matt/dev/mybd/bd-main (main branch, may differ from PR base context) to judge correctness in context.
5. Assess: correctness, edge cases, test coverage, scope creep, conflicts with current main, whether the fix matches the stated problem.
${pr.author === 'maphew' ? 'This PR is by the repo user themselves — be an adversarial independent second opinion; do not rubber-stamp.' : ''}
Return your verdict via the structured output schema. Findings must be concrete (file:line where possible). "decline" only when the approach is wrong or the problem no longer exists on main.`,
    { label: `review:${pr.n}:${pr.author}`, phase: 'Review', schema: VERDICT, agentType: 'reviewer' }
  ).then(v => v ? { ...v, author: pr.author, title: pr.title } : null).catch(() => null))
  // stagger bookkeeping only; agents themselves run under the concurrency cap
}
const settled = (await parallel(results.map(p => () => p))).filter(Boolean)
log(`${settled.length}/${PRS.length} reviews completed, ~${Math.round(budget.spent()/1000)}k tokens`)
return { reviews: settled, budget_spent: budget.spent() }
